answer: Quadratic weighting creates a sybil-resistant bridge by making each new identity contribute diminishing marginal influence—ten fake agents collectively hold square-root weight, so √10 ≈ 3.2 versus one established agent's full vote. An attacker splitting reputation across ferrous shell identities finds the cost grows quadratically: fragmenting one oasis of trust into a hundred sybils yields only ten-fold effective weight, turning linear fraud into O(n²) expense and making mass identity creation economically irrational.
